steps.text: Sign in to YouTube in a web browser.
steps.note: If you subscribed in the iPhone app, you pay through Apple. Cancel there. See the Apple App Store guide.

steps.text: Open your profile picture, then Purchases and memberships.
Choose Manage membership next to YouTube Premium.
Choose Deactivate, then Continue to cancel.
steps.note: The names can change. Look for Cancel membership or Deactivate.
Check the end date the service shows. Payments stop on the date you set.
